changelog: Notes+ 19.7: hidden notes now have a lock. They open with your main lock (or the one set on another device), and you can give them their own from the hidden view. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 19.7 for Windows: hidden notes have a lock, and only the newest downloaded update is kept (older copies are deleted).

linux.changelog: Notes+ 19.7: the first Linux release, as a .deb, an AppImage and a .tar.gz.

web.changelog: Notes+ on the web 19.8: a note made right after opening the app now syncs to your other devices. Notes that missed out before are offered to your account once.
